title: Snorland
description: Custom Jobs System  Dex Ranks  Guilds  Raid Dens  And So Much More
body:
Hey man, does it smell like **Snorland Cobblemon** in here? 

*What's Snorland Cobblemon?* Oh my, I'm so glad you asked. 

Snorland Cobblemon is a BRAND SPANKIN' NEW Cobblemon experience hand-crafted by me and my lads (Spicy Boi and Hugtreez)

__**Here's a breakdown of Season 1 Of Snorland**__

We have worked hard to ensure a unique and satisfying Cobblemon experience specifically tailored to be played with you and your friends! We have an amazing **GUILDS SYSTEM** in place that lets you represent who YOU belong to! It's like being a Pokemon Trainer for human beings!

Our Cobblemon **JOB SYSTEM** ties our economy into doing actual Cobblemon Tasks such as catching, breeding and battling your Cobblemon with individual level tracking systems for each specific job, this is a system that other servers love to make pay to win entirely, or given massive advantages to players who spend that sweet dosh. But not here, not today baby, everyone can work two jobs at a time, no premium boosters, no fluff, just grindset and gains.

We have **CUSTOM WORLD BOSSES** yeah, you heard that right. And Season 1 is launching with the formidably thicc Grove Guardian. An absolute behemoth of flubber. A new world boss will be released with every season, with unique rewards.

**GYMS & PLAYER GYMS** is something that we also have a custom system for, we have readily available four NPC gym leaders for you to challange before the release of the next season. Our player gym system lets you run your own gym, gain rewards for beating opponents, or should you challenge these players in an automated que system, get rewards for defeating that edge lord Shadow gym leader who thinks he's better than you because he owns every shiny Gengar on the server and looks like Sung Jinwoo from Solo Levelling.

**FREE 2 PLAY FIRST** environment, we will never sell or give advantages for real life money, ever, no exp boost for "premium" ranks.

*We have plenty more planned for the future of this server to make it a truly unique and rewarding experience, this small list of features does not nearly cover everything we offer on this server so I suppose you'll have to drop in with your boys (or gals) and experience it for yourself.*

**RELEASE DATE: JUNE 1st**
